readme_cases.expected:
`python -m gamelab run mod-firearms --mode lab`: `[HWP:firearms] class registered with 3 subclass(es)`, no
   "missing item/unit" lines, no script or sval errors.

Create a character: Firearms Specialist is in the class list with the
   round icon; the character spawns with a Service Pistol in the main hand.

Clip: `python -m gamelab run plan-t14 --mode lab`. Covers the 30-round
   spawn fill, 1 round and no mana per shot, the launcher's mana cost, the empty
   clip (Reloading, won't fire, refills), the dodge restart and Reload.

Guns: `python -m gamelab run plan-firearms-guns --mode lab`. Covers
   magazines 10/20/30 and the rounds each loadout's clicks take.
   `plan-firearms-cannon`: the Hand Cannon alone, mixed with a pistol either
   way round, paired, in the off hand, the Flamethrower Rifle's mana drain and the
   Full Auto Rifle's rate and spread. `look-firearms-cannon` pictures their models,
   rounds, flame and icons.
Frag grenade lands where aimed and explodes; damage numbers appear.

Specializations and orbs: `plan-firearms-a` (Frag, the picker, Marksman),
   `plan-firearms-b` (Demolitionist, Assault) and `plan-firearms-orbs` (the
   Reload and Frag orbs). Orbs are taken with `gl orb <id>` (the sphere's
   SkillTempUp). `plan-firearms-reload-cut`: an ability or the swap cuts a
   reload, and the saved-rank move for skills that start at rank 1
   (`hwp firearms startranks`).

Over-Reload by hand: empty the clip, watch the bar above the health bar,
   press Reload (or left click) in the gold; the clip shows +6. Then Reload
   with rounds left and press Reload again in the gold: still +6, not +12.
   Miss it: the white turns red and a second press does nothing. Without the
   orb the white bar still fills on every reload.

Ordinance Hoarder by hand: wait 8 s with the rocket ready, fire twice in a
   row.

Co-op: a client sees the host's bullets, grenades and rockets, and the
   other way round.

readme_cases.expected:
`python -m gamelab run mod-weaponswap --mode lab`: no script errors; `hwp swap` twice logs `set 2 in hand` /
   `set 1 in hand`.

Solo: press X with a sword -> hands empty, the sword shows in the alt slot
   of the character screen, the HUD tip appears. Equip a bow, press X -> sword
   back, bow in the alt slot; each swap takes 2 s standing still. X during
   the channel, or a dodge, cancels it ("Swap cancelled"), the weapons stay.
Click the alt main-hand slot in the character screen: the sets swap.
Save and reload: the alt slots still show the other set; swap works.
A two-hander in the other set: the alt off-hand slot mirrors it, dimmed.

Plus tab: click "Swap weapons", press R: the button says R, R swaps, X
   does not (`mod-options-tab` covers the rebind). `hwp swapkey 21 R` does the same. `hwp swapdrop`: items land in
   the inventory, the alt slots empty.
Co-op: the other player sees your weapon change on swap.
